Server module¶

MOOD server entry point.

This module implements the MOOD game server with support for multiple clients, wandering monsters, chat and localization.

mood.server.__main__.broadcast_raw(message_by_locale)¶

Send message to all clients using per-client locale.

mood.server.__main__.encounter_at(pos)¶

Notify all players at given position about a monster encounter.

mood.server.__main__.get_translation(locale)¶

Get translation object for given locale.

mood.server.__main__.handle_client(conn, addr)¶

Handle a single client connection lifecycle.

mood.server.__main__.handle_command(username, line)¶

Handle a command received from a client.

mood.server.__main__.main()¶

Start the MOOD server and wandering monster thread.

mood.server.__main__.run_server(host='127.0.0.1', port=5555)¶

Start the MOOD server on given host and port.

mood.server.__main__.send_localized(username, message_by_locale)¶

Send localized message to a specific client.

mood.server.__main__.send_raw(username, message)¶

Send raw string message to a specific client.

mood.server.__main__.wander_monsters()¶

Move a random monster one cell every WANDER_INTERVAL seconds.
